monitors.title: Claude Cookbook
include_filters: xpath:for-each(//a[starts-with(@href, '/cookbook/') and not(contains(@href, '?')) and @href != '/cookbook/']/@href, function($a) { concat('https://platform.claude.com', $a) })

monitors.title: OpenAI Developer Blog
include_filters: xpath:for-each(//a[starts-with(@href, '/blog/') or starts-with(@href, 'https://developers.openai.com/blog/')]/@href, function($a) { if (starts-with($a, 'http')) then string($a) else concat('https://developers.openai.com', $a) })

monitors.title: OpenAI Engineering
include_filters: xpath:for-each(//main//a[starts-with(@href, '/index/') or starts-with(@href, 'https://openai.com/index/')]/@href, function($a) { if (starts-with($a, 'http')) then string($a) else concat('https://openai.com', $a) })
